entities.name: Jornstad
entities.description: The biggest city in Eastern Kjeldor on Terisiare during the Ice Age, on the border of Fyndhorn.

entities.name: Lord Rothchild
entities.description: Lived and worked from Jornstad; possibly regent while the capital was there.

entities.name: Rothchild Park
entities.description: Well-kept public gardens on Jornstad's main avenue.

entities.name: Eastern Kjeldor
entities.description: Region of Terisiare where Jornstad lay.

entities.name: Fyndhorn
entities.description: Forest on whose border Jornstad lay.

entities.name: Krov
entities.description: Capital of Kjeldor at the end of the Ice Age.

entities.name: Kjeld
entities.description: Royal city of Kjeldor at the end of the Ice Age.

entities.name: Flooding of Terisiare
entities.description: Event in which Fyndhorn, and likely Jornstad, fell beneath the ocean.

events.summary: Jornstad likely fell beneath the ocean with Fyndhorn during the Flooding of Terisiare.
events.quote: it likely fell beneath the ocean along with the forest during the Flooding of Terisiare

relations.quote: Jornstad was the biggest city in Eastern Kjeldor .
